inputs.public_source: Xu, Wang, Ramdas (2024), Post-selection inference for e-value based confidence intervals, DOI 10.1214/24-EJS2253

actions: Derived exact nine-split selector-distortion numerical-coverage bound 2*delta/c(K) from target-selection geometry and true-parameter evidence ratios.
Specialized V3 mixture ratios to score-independent component denominator bounds.
Extended the result to moving running weighted-average conditional means by pointwise domination with true conditional-mean supermartingales.
Derived a data-free K guard on the domain both true channel means <=mu0 using d_lambda(0)=1 and monotonic denominator geometry.
Numerically audited the alternating .25/1 exposure-weight schedule: K<=5 through prefix 31 and K>5 from prefix 32 for the declared safe-domain guard.
Ran two 100000-trajectory horizon-300 V3-shaped off-target Bernoulli stresses; observed selected crossing rates 3.097% and 3.189%, respectively.
Persisted helper, validations, checkpoint, advanced role-local LATEST, and verified readback.

termination.cause: Invocation checkpoint boundary after substantive theorem, validation and durable readback; research remains open-ended.
termination.exact_next_action: Build the production-path K guard from actual predictable weights and prove/test a lifetime-valid handoff to fresh-confirm without resetting or double-spending the reporting alpha.
